zh.title: 千葉豪雨影響成田聯外交通 台灣虎航開放3航班免費改期退款
zh.summary: 受日本千葉豪雨影響，台灣虎航針對成田機場受阻旅客提供免費改期與退款方案。
body: 日本千葉縣發生暴雨，導致連接東京成田機場的當地大眾運輸工具停駛，影響部分旅客前往機場搭機。台灣虎航於2026年8月14日在官網公告應變處理方案，針對因成田機場聯外交通受阻而未能如期搭乘指定航班的旅客，提供免費改期或退款至信用帳戶等彈性措施。
台灣虎航指出，相關應變方案適用於3個特定的成田航線航班，包含2026年8月13日由東京成田飛往桃園的IT701班機，以及8月14日由東京成田飛往桃園的IT201班機與飛往高雄的IT281班機。若上述航班已正常起飛，但旅客因交通中斷未能如期搭乘（No Show），可向東京成田機場的台灣虎航櫃檯尋求協助，若7日內其他航班仍有空位，將免費協助調整航班。
此外，受影響旅客亦可在2026年8月16日晚間9時前，主動聯繫台灣虎航客服中心處理。客服團隊將協助免費改期至7日內仍有空位的航班；或依不可抗力因素規範，提供退還款項至信用帳戶（代金券），供旅客於未來安排行程時使用。若旅客原購票管道為旅行社或第三方平台，則需洽詢原開票旅行社或平台進行處理。
針對千葉暴雨對整體航班營運的影響，星宇航空表示，受交通影響而未如期搭機（No Show）的旅客數量較平時略增，但目前航班均無異動。中華航空表示整體營運皆正常；長榮航空則表示，當天稍早由成田前往高雄的航班中，僅有1名旅客未能如期搭乘。

en.title: Chiba Rain Impairs Narita Transit: Tigerair Taiwan Offers Rebooking and Refunds
en.summary: Tigerair Taiwan offers free flight rebooking and refunds after Chiba heavy rain disrupts Narita Airport ground transit.
body: Heavy rain in Chiba Prefecture, Japan, has disrupted local public transportation to Tokyo Narita Airport, preventing some passengers from reaching the airport on time. In response to the ground transit disruptions, Tigerair Taiwan issued an official announcement on August 14, 2026, outlining flexible ticketing measures, including free flight modifications and refunds to credit accounts for affected travelers.

The flexible measures apply to passengers booked on three specific routes operated by Tigerair Taiwan: flight IT701 from Tokyo Narita to Taoyuan on August 13, as well as flight IT201 from Tokyo Narita to Taoyuan and flight IT281 from Tokyo Narita to Kaohsiung on August 14. For passengers who missed these flights (no-show) after the aircraft had departed normally due to transit delays, assistance is available at the airline's Narita Airport counter to adjust their flights free of charge to alternative flights within seven days, subject to seat availability.

Passengers may also contact the Tigerair Taiwan customer service center prior to 9:00 p.m. on August 16, 2026. Customer service staff will assist in rebooking free of charge on open flights within seven days or issue a refund to a credit account as a voucher under force majeure provisions for future travel. Travelers who purchased tickets through travel agencies or third-party booking platforms are instructed to contact their original ticketing platform to process modifications or refunds.

Regarding wider operational impacts from the Chiba rainstorm, Starlux Airlines stated that its no-show passenger volume was slightly higher than usual, though all flight schedules remain unchanged. China Airlines reported normal operations across its flights, while EVA Air noted that only a single passenger failed to show up for an earlier flight operating from Narita to Kaohsiung.

zh.title: 瑞士新創PeakJet完成首航 拓展歐洲半私人航空市場
zh.summary: PeakJet完成蘇黎世至馬略卡首航；以輕資產模式進軍歐洲半私人航線
body: 瑞士半私人航空平台 PeakJet 於 2026 年 8 月 1 日完成首航，執飛由蘇黎世（ZRH）至馬略卡島帕爾馬（PMI）的航線。該平台旨在引進半私人飛行概念，投入歐洲短途航空市場。
本次航班由 VistaJet GmbH 使用巴西航空工業 Embraer 650 Legacy 執飛。PeakJet 未持有航空營運人許可證，採用輕資產平台模式營運。公司由前阿提哈德航空執行長 Peter Baumgartner 及高管 Gianni Tronza 共同創立，後續規劃連接蘇黎世至尼斯（NCE）與馬拉加（AGP）等航線，專注 2.5 小時以內的航程。

en.title: Swiss Startup PeakJet Launches Semi-Private Europe Flights With Inaugural Zurich Flight
en.summary: PeakJet completed its inaugural Zurich to Palma flight on August 1 using VistaJet operated aircraft.
body: Swiss semi-private aviation platform PeakJet completed its inaugural flight on August 1, 2026, operating between Zurich (ZRH)                                                                                                                    and Palma de Mallorca (PMI)                                                                                                                   . The flight was operated by VistaJet GmbH using an Embraer 650 Legacy aircraft, marking the startup's entry into the European short-haul market.

PeakJet operates as an asset-light technology platform without holding its own air operator certificate. Co-founded by former Etihad Airways CEO Peter Baumgartner and aviation executive Gianni Tronza, the company plans to target routes connecting Zurich with Nice (NCE)                                                                                                                    and Malaga (AGP)                                                                                                                   , focusing on flights under 2.5 hours.

facts.claim: PeakJet completed its first flight between Zurich (ZRH) and Palma de Mallorca (PMI) on August 1, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: On August 1, 2026, coinciding with Switzerland’s national day, PeakJet completed its first flight between Zurich (ZRH) and Palma de Mallorca (PMI).

facts.claim: The inaugural flight was operated by VistaJet GmbH using an Embraer 650 Legacy aircraft, as PeakJet does not hold an air operator certificate.
facts.sourceQuote: The flight was operated by VistaJet Gmbh (the German subsidiary of the well-known executive aviation group) using Embraer 650 Legacy. This is a key element in PeakJet’s business model, since the startup doesn’t hold its own air operator certificate (AOC).

facts.claim: PeakJet was set up by Gianni Tronza and Peter Baumgartner, former Chief Executive Officer of Etihad Airways.
facts.sourceQuote: At the helm of this project is Gianni Tronza, a Swiss executive with decades of experience across the industry who has held senior executive roles at airlines such as Etihad Airways, American Airlines, British Airways and Crossair, the kernel of what later became SWISS. Also backing this project is Peter Baumgartner, former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at Etihad Airways

facts.claim: PeakJet focuses on short-haul flights up to 2.5 hours, targeting routes connecting Zurich to Mallorca, Nice (NCE), and Malaga (AGP).
facts.sourceQuote: the focus on the short-haul, defined as flights of up to 2.5 hours. Second home owners is one of the key demographics that PeakJet is targeting, hence the initial choice of routes, linking Zurich to Mallorca, Nice (NCE) and Malaga (AGP).
